name: Dates & business calendar
description: Business-day arithmetic, SLA due times within working hours, durations and ages, time zone conversion, recurring schedules and fiscal periods.

operations.label: Add business days
operations.description: Add (or with a negative number, subtract) business days to a date, skipping weekends and holidays. Adding 0 returns the date itself, or the next business day when it falls on a weekend or holiday.

inputs.name: date
inputs.label: Date
inputs.description: The starting date (YYYY-MM-DD).

inputs.name: days
inputs.label: Business days
inputs.description: How many business days to add; negative to go back.

inputs.name: weekend_days
inputs.label: Weekend days
inputs.description: Days that are not business days (names such as Saturday, or ISO numbers 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday).

inputs.name: holidays
inputs.label: Holidays
inputs.description: Dates that are not business days, as YYYY-MM-DD (a list, or one per line).

outputs.name: calendar_days
outputs.label: Calendar days
outputs.description: Calendar days between the start and the result (negative when going back).

operations.label: SLA due time
operations.description: The moment a number of working hours after a start time runs out, counting only working hours on working days in a time zone and skipping holidays. Daylight-saving changes are handled: working hours are wall-clock times.

inputs.name: start
inputs.label: Start
inputs.description: When the clock starts (ISO 8601). Without Z or an offset it is local time in Time zone.

inputs.name: hours
inputs.label: Working hours
inputs.description: The SLA in working hours (decimals allowed, e.g. 0.5).

inputs.name: working_hours
inputs.label: Working hours of the day
inputs.description: Start and end of the working day, e.g. 09:00-17:00 (use 00:00-24:00 for round the clock).

inputs.name: working_days
inputs.label: Working days
inputs.description: Weekdays that have working hours (names or ISO numbers 1–7).

inputs.name: time_zone
inputs.label: Time zone
inputs.description: IANA time zone of the working hours and holidays.

inputs.name: holidays
inputs.label: Holidays
inputs.description: Dates that are not business days, as YYYY-MM-DD (a list, or one per line).

outputs.name: due
outputs.label: Due (UTC)
outputs.description: The due moment as an ISO 8601 UTC instant.

outputs.name: due_local
outputs.label: Due (local)
outputs.description: The due moment in the time zone, with its offset, e.g. 2026-11-09T14:30:00+13:00.

outputs.name: start_local
outputs.label: Start (local)
outputs.description: The start in the time zone, with its offset.

outputs.name: calendar_hours
outputs.label: Calendar hours
outputs.description: Elapsed real time from start to due, in hours.

operations.label: Duration / age
operations.description: The time between two dates or date-times: calendar days, business days, hours and minutes, a readable text and the age in years, months and days. Negative when To is before From.

inputs.name: from
inputs.label: From
inputs.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date-time.

inputs.name: to
inputs.label: To
inputs.description: Date or date-time; empty for now.

inputs.name: time_zone
inputs.label: Time zone
inputs.description: Time zone for dates and times without an offset, and for counting calendar days.

inputs.name: weekend_days
inputs.label: Weekend days
inputs.description: Days that are not business days (names such as Saturday, or ISO numbers 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday).

inputs.name: holidays
inputs.label: Holidays
inputs.description: Dates that are not business days, as YYYY-MM-DD (a list, or one per line).

outputs.name: business_days
outputs.label: Business days
outputs.description: Business days after From up to and including To.

outputs.name: human
outputs.label: As text
outputs.description: For example "36 years, 3 months, 17 days" or "2 hours, 15 minutes".

operations.label: Convert time zone
operations.description: Show a moment in another time zone: the UTC instant, the local date-time with its offset, date, time and weekday.

inputs.name: datetime
inputs.label: Date-time
inputs.description: ISO 8601. Without Z or an offset it is read in From zone.

inputs.name: from_zone
inputs.label: From zone
inputs.description: IANA time zone of a date-time without an offset.

inputs.name: to_zone
inputs.label: To zone
inputs.description: IANA time zone to show the moment in.

operations.label: Next occurrences
operations.description: The next dates of a recurring schedule: daily, weekly on chosen days, monthly on a day of the month or the nth weekday (e.g. last Friday), or yearly, every N periods, at a time of day in a time zone.

inputs.name: frequency
inputs.label: Frequency
inputs.description: How often it repeats.

inputs.name: interval
inputs.label: Every
inputs.description: Repeat every N days / weeks / months / years.

inputs.name: days_of_week
inputs.label: Days of the week
inputs.description: Weekly: the days (names or ISO numbers); default the weekday of Start.

inputs.name: day_of_month
inputs.label: Day of the month
inputs.description: Monthly / yearly: 1–31 (later than the month has = its last day) or -1 for the last day; default the day of Start.

inputs.name: nth_week
inputs.label: Nth weekday
inputs.description: Monthly / yearly: instead of a day of the month, the first … fourth or last Weekday.

inputs.name: weekday
inputs.label: Weekday
inputs.description: With Nth weekday: Monday … Sunday.

inputs.name: month
inputs.label: Month
inputs.description: Yearly: 1–12; default the month of Start.

inputs.name: time
inputs.label: Time of day
inputs.description: Local time of each occurrence (HH:mm).

inputs.name: time_zone
inputs.label: Time zone
inputs.description: IANA time zone of the schedule.

inputs.name: after
inputs.label: After
inputs.description: List occurrences after this moment; empty for now.

inputs.name: start
inputs.label: Start
inputs.description: First possible date of the schedule (the anchor for Every N); default the date of After.

inputs.name: count
inputs.label: How many
inputs.description: Number of occurrences to return (1–100).

inputs.name: exclude_dates
inputs.label: Skip dates
inputs.description: Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to leave out, e.g. holidays.

outputs.name: next
outputs.label: Next
outputs.description: The next occurrence (UTC instant); empty when none was found.

operations.label: Fiscal period
operations.description: The fiscal year, quarter and period (month) of a date for a fiscal year starting in any month, with the start and end dates of the period, quarter and year and a label such as FY2027 Q2.

inputs.name: date
inputs.label: Date
inputs.description: The date; empty for today (in Time zone).

inputs.name: start_month
inputs.label: Fiscal year starts in month
inputs.description: 1 = January … 12 = December, e.g. 7 for July (Australia, NZ public sector), 4 for April (UK, India, Japan, Canada).

inputs.name: year_naming
inputs.label: Fiscal year named by
inputs.description: The calendar year in which the fiscal year ends (FY2027 = July 2026–June 2027) or starts.

inputs.name: time_zone
inputs.label: Time zone
inputs.description: For "today" when Date is empty.

summary: Date logic workflows need: add business days around weekends and holidays, compute SLA due times within working hours in any time zone (DST-safe), measure durations and ages, convert between time zones, list the next occurrences of a schedule and find the fiscal year, quarter and period of a date.
purpose: Get deadlines, schedules and reporting periods right in one step, including time zones, daylight saving and holidays.
recommended_for: Service-level deadlines, approval due dates, payment terms, recurring reviews, reporting periods and anything that depends on business days.
setup_notes: Pure computation: no network, data or secrets. Nothing to configure after installing.
Time zones are IANA names (Pacific/Auckland, America/New_York, Europe/London). A date-time without Z or an offset is read as wall-clock time in the operation's time zone.
Holidays are an explicit list of YYYY-MM-DD dates: keep them in a data table or workflow variable and map them in.
author: UserTasks
